crossRefs.note: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

translations.web: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.
translations.bsb: and the height of each cherub was ten cubits.
translations.kjv: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
translations.asv: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
